question: Can I carry over unused sick days to next year?
answer: No. You get up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year, and any unused sick days cannot be carried over to the next year or paid out.

question: What is the daily allowance for a work trip to Ghana?
answer: A work trip to Ghana counts as international travel, so the per diem is USD 60 per day. It covers meals and local incidentals and is paid for each night you spend away from home.

question: I'm in grade 6 and worked 5 extra approved hours last week. Will I get overtime pay?
answer: No. Employees in grade 5 and above are not paid overtime, so as a grade 6 employee you will instead receive time off in lieu (TOIL) at 1 hour off per approved extra hour, which gives you 5 hours of TOIL for last week. You must use this TOIL within 2 months or it is lost.

question: Can I claim my gym membership as an expense?
answer: No. Gym costs count as personal entertainment, which the Expense Reimbursement Policy lists as not reimbursable.

question: What is the hotel limit for an international trip?
answer: For international trips, hotels are capped at USD 180 per night. The only exception is when the Travel Desk confirms that no suitable option is available within that limit.

question: Can I work from Spain for two weeks while visiting family?
answer: Yes, potentially. You may work fully remotely for up to 2 weeks (10 working days) per calendar year, which covers a two-week family visit if you haven't used this allowance already this year. You need line manager approval in PeopleHub at least 5 working days in advance. Because Spain is outside Nigeria, you also need approval from People & Culture for tax and legal reasons.

question: I want to take a 4-day holiday. How far ahead must I request it?
answer: A 4-day holiday is more than 3 consecutive working days, so you must request it at least 10 working days in advance. Submit the request through the PeopleHub portal. Your leave is not confirmed until your line manager approves it in PeopleHub.

question: I'm a senior engineer (not a Director) flying 7 hours to London. Can I fly business class?
answer: No. For flights longer than 6 hours, only Director level and above may fly business class. As a senior engineer on a 7-hour flight, you would travel premium economy where available, otherwise economy.

question: How much is the home working allowance and is it taxed?
answer: Hybrid employees receive an internet and utilities allowance of NGN 25,000 per month, paid with salary. The policy documents do not say whether this allowance is taxed.
